mapper.sql: select app_user_id, nickname, oa_openid, mini_openid, unionid, phone, phone_consent_time, phone_consent_version, primary_visitor_id, register_channel, register_content, login_count, last_login_time, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from abr_app_user
mapper.select: where del_flag = '0' and status = #{status} and register_channel = #{registerChannel} and nickname like concat('%', #{nickname}, '%') and create_time >= cast(#{params.beginTime} as date) and create_time < cast(#{params.endTime} as date) + interval '1 day' order by app_user_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into abr_app_user (nickname, oa_openid, mini_openid, unionid, register_channel, register_content, login_count, last_login_time, status, create_by, create_time) values (coalesce(#{nickname}, ''), #{oaOpenid}, #{miniOpenid}, #{unionid}, coalesce(#{registerChannel}, 'direct'), coalesce(#{registerContent}, ''), 1, now(), '0', 'app', now())
mapper.update: update abr_app_user set login_count = coalesce(login_count, 0) + 1, last_login_time = now(), oa_openid = coalesce(oa_openid, #{oaOpenid}), unionid = coalesce(unionid, #{unionid}), update_time = now() where app_user_id = #{appUserId}
update abr_app_user set primary_visitor_id = #{visitorId}, update_time = now() where app_user_id = #{appUserId} and primary_visitor_id is null
update abr_app_user set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where app_user_id = #{appUserId}
